title: prune run record
description: run.json inside each run folder, written by `scripts/prune.mjs step` when an agent session finishes with a usable diff. A folder without it is an unfinished run and is redone. The folder also holds diff.patch, message.txt and output.log.

run.description: 1-based index within this section, arm and harness.

model.description: The model ID the session ran on, as the harness reported it. Data only.

model_pinned.description: true when the run pinned the model instead of taking the harness default.

pin_reason.description: Why the model was pinned: --model, or the adapter's own reason when it always runs one model. null when the run took the harness default.

base_commit.description: The target repo commit the run's worktree branched from. Grading context and prune.json's commit come from it, not from the repo's HEAD at grading time.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths the agent changed or added.

diff_bytes.description: Size of the full diff before any cut.

diff_sha256.description: SHA-256 of diff.patch as stored. The grading question's id hashes it with the run's slot, the § text and the probe, so a redone run gets a new question.

usage.description: Token counts the harness reported, when it reports them. Data only.

loaded.description: What the session reported loading at start, so a reader can check that no skill, plugin or tool server carried a rule into the arm. null when the harness does not report it.
